eyebrow: A managed identity, not a connection string
code:
az vm create --name harrowpeak-app-vm \
  --resource-group harrowpeak-prod-rg \
  --subnet app-subnet --size Standard_D2s_v5 \
  --assign-identity --image Ubuntu2204

az role assignment create \
  --assignee <harrowpeak-app-vm-principal-id> \
  --role "Storage Blob Data Contributor" \
  --scope /subscriptions/.../storageAccounts/harrowpeakstorage
caption: The VM authenticates to storage as itself -- no key, no password, nothing to leak or rotate.
